$comment: Manifest mode, used by the Windows build only. It exists to PIN libuv.
Classic `vcpkg install libuv:x64-windows-static` resolves to whatever is
current, which put libuv 1.52.1 into the v0.5.0 Windows binaries — the
version with the UDP POLLERR regression that silently wedges established
cpp/CMakeLists.txt fails the build if the resolved version is a bad one;
this file is what keeps it from being resolved in the first place.
libsodium is deliberately left unpinned: no known version constraint.
Bump builtin-baseline to pick up newer ports; the libuv override holds.
name: nospoon
